sources.note: Sangeet Natak Akademi’s heritage entry reproduces the shared Chhau inscription description: three styles, movement vocabulary and 2010 recognition. It is not separate corroboration of UNESCO.

sources.inspection: Actual page directly inspected on 20 October 2026. This official Sangeet Natak Akademi entry reproduces the established UNESCO description; the existing chhau source and their shared wording remain recorded.
limits: Shared SNA and UNESCO wording is one account, not independent corroboration. No universal male-only rule, classical status or fixed performance format inferred.

locators.detail-1: Training recollection after the Gwalior account: Delhi years, daily exercises and posture notebooks.
locators.detail-1-p-0: Same training passage: the teacher refining and experimenting with movement.
locators.detail-2: Following training paragraphs: learning Dandi and reflecting on renunciation as a young student.

sources.inspection: Actual full HTML text inspected on 20 October 2026: selected first-person training and Dandi passages. Article dated 27 September 2023. Other biographical, political and institutional historical claims were not adopted.
limits: Retrospective testimony attributed to Sharma; not a universal training sequence or definitive interpretation of Dandi.
No archival photographs reused or training film viewed. No technical definitions inferred from terms alone.
